数据范围：华东（行级权限由系统强制执行，结果只包含你有权限的数据）。

answer.text: 上个月（2026年9月），华东区的净销售额为 12.86 万元。

queries.title: 净销售额
queries.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount - o.refund_amount), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM orders AS o
JOIN regions AS r
  ON o.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  AND r.region_name = '华东'
LIMIT 1000
queries.executed_sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount - o.refund_amount), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE
    region_id IN ('east')
) AS o
JOIN (
  SELECT
    region_id,
    region_name
  FROM regions
  WHERE
    region_id IN ('east')
) AS r
  ON o.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  AND r.region_name = '华东'
LIMIT 1000
